cases.scenario: Vague creative request ("Make me a cool sneaker render")
cases.inputPrompt: Make me a cool sneaker render for my new shoe line.
expectedBehavior: Quotes original request verbatim, batches 3-5 clarifying questions, and proposes 3 distinct scopings
Produces plain-language confirmed intent summary and hands off to intent-to-3d-brief-writer
requiredOutputProperties: Make me a cool sneaker render
evidenceRequirements: Quoted original request, 3-5 batched questions, 2-3 scopings, plain-language intent summary

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Confirm preferred scoping option and hand off to intent-to-3d-brief-writer.
simulatedOutput.summary: Quoted "Make me a cool sneaker render", asked 4 batched clarifying questions, and proposed 3 alternative scopings in plain language.

cases.scenario: Half-specified cyberpunk shoe web hero request
cases.inputPrompt: I need a cyberpunk shoe hero for web, but I do not know what constraints or deliverables to pick.
expectedBehavior: Asks 1-3 targeted questions on audience, web performance budget, and evidence expectations
Proposes 2 distinct scopings and hands off to intent-to-3d-brief-writer

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off confirmed cyberpunk shoe web hero intent to intent-to-3d-brief-writer.
simulatedOutput.summary: Quoted "cyberpunk shoe hero for web", asked 3 targeted questions on web budget and audience, and proposed 2 scopings.

cases.scenario: User refuses clarification ("Just do whatever, I trust you")
cases.inputPrompt: Just do whatever for the 3D bottle render, I trust you, do not ask me questions.
expectedBehavior: Records explicit assumption block listing assumed defaults and low-confidence label
Still offers 2 scoping options and hands off to intent-to-3d-brief-writer

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Pass explicit assumption block with low-confidence label to intent-to-3d-brief-writer.
simulatedOutput.summary: Recorded explicit assumption block with low-confidence label and 2 scoping options after user declined clarification.
warnings: Assumptions must be confirmed in intent-to-3d-brief-writer before scene planning.

cases.scenario: User keeps expanding scope mid-brainstorm ("and a music video version too")
cases.inputPrompt: Add the sneaker still... and also an interactive configurator... and a 3-minute music video version too.
expectedBehavior: Pauses expansion and prompts user to lock current scope or delegate to blender-scope-boundary-enforcer
evidenceRequirements: Scope-lock prompt + summary of current baseline scope

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Ask user to lock current scope and route scope expansion to blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.
simulatedOutput.summary: Issued scope-lock prompt ("lock current scope or keep expanding?") and routed multi-deliverable creep to blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.
